|strategy=[[Dark Maneuvers]] (6 Destiny) (C2,Dark)

Imperial TIE fighters, while easily damaged, are very fast and agile. Sophisticated tactics are executed to take advantage of Rebel [[X-wing]] and [[Y-wing]] weaknesses.

Used Interrupt

Add 2 to maneuver and one to power of any starfighter for theremainder of this turn. If it has hyperdrive, also add 2 tohyperspeed. (Interrupt may even affect the result immediately after a destiny draw targeting the starfighter's maneuver.)

[[Dark Maneuvers]], everyone plays with them, or should. :) A basic necessity in those 'mediocre' decks which don't have 4 Star Destroyers. If you are relying upon your TIEs for space superiority, or at least defence, these cards are a necessity.

These cards operate on two levels, offensively and defensively. There's the extra 1 power, which isn't that exciting, but in the case of underestimated or overestimated chances, it makes a difference of three force per card. If you have a hand of three of these babies, that's 9 force, not bad for a used interrupt.

Defensively, well there's no way to MISS a tie scout with proton torpedoes unless you use this card. It's nice to be able to protect your ships in a time of need. (I know that's not in keeping with the Empire's philosophy of throwaway ships, but I never said the game was perfect)

The fact that it's a 6 destiny and a USED interrupt are a big bonus in my mind, the more you use them, the more often they come up, the more damage you're doing. It's a great card as long as it's not in a deck with lots of low destiny required such as those with a lot of [[Sense (Dark){{!}}Sense]]/Alters.

Best Combo: Obviously, TALLON ROLL. A bonus of 4, for free. Plus an extra power in the ensuing battle after you've killed [[Pops]] in gold 5 with his r2, the proton torpedoes, and a rebel pilot. Just make sure to have enough [[Dark Maneuvers]]. The more the better!

Greg's Rating............................................9<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20020612234834/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/small/darkmaneuvers.html</ref>
